label: The tolerance window
subgoals: Form the window from (1 - epsilon) A/2 to (1 + epsilon) A/2
Use area, not cell count, when cell sizes differ

label: Checking a move
subgoals: Subtract the cell's area from its side
Add it to the other side
Accept the move only if both sides stay in the window

label: Why exhaustive search is hopeless
subgoals: Note the growth like 2 to the n over root n
Rely on heuristics because minimum bisection is NP-hard
